description:
Show the Fittest population: model agents (answerers) and the Skeptic (critic) with reputations from the ledger, the calibration domain, tau and the verdict rule, which models are live, and the evolution family trees if published.

Logging: every call to this server is logged (UTC time, tool name, an anonymous client id = salted hash of client name + IP), structure and atom counts, verdict counts, latency and ok/error category. Raw IPs are not stored by the app or written to the access log; since 2026-10-31 19:11 UTC Caddy's error/unmapped-host logs drop them too (before that, some Caddy error and bare-IP entries in the system journal contained client IPs, kept until journal rotation). Structures, coordinates, element lists and names are NOT stored. Aggregate counts are public at /stats.
name: swarm_status
